acceptedFindings.title: Manuscript contradicts available data artifacts
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: The manuscript states 'No estimate-like records were available for p-value/effect-size checks', yet the stats-run artifact contains an odds_ratio (2.78) and p_value (0.00054), rendering the manuscript inaccurate and untrustworthy.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Regenerate the manuscript from current artifacts and ensure all statements are consistent with the run output.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check if the manuscript reports an odds ratio = 2.78 and p = 0.0005; it does not mention them, contradicting the stats-run estimates.

acceptedFindings.title: Variable definitions missing for outcome_binary and treatment
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Without clinical definitions of the exposure and outcome, the findings are uninterpretable and cannot inform any decision.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Provide a data dictionary or companion variable artifact defining the variables in clinical terms (e.g., what treatment, what outcome).
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: The manuscript admits variables were not encoded; no variable artifact is included in the review packet.

acceptedFindings.title: Analysis not bound to a pre-specified analysis plan, making it exploratory yet presented as confirmatory
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: An unbound analysis is vulnerable to p-hacking and lacks the integrity needed for evidence claims.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Create and bind a method-selection artifact and AnalysisSpec before run, or clearly label the result as purely exploratory and not for inference.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Verify that stats-run.json binding has methodSelectionPath set and specHash valid, and that resultPosture status is bound.

acceptedFindings.title: No confounding control in observational analysis
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Even strictly associative claims require consideration of confounding. Presenting a univariate odds ratio from a 2×2 table without any adjustment or matching can be misleading and does not support any meaningful inference.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Either restrict the report to purely descriptive statistics (without odds ratio) or conduct an adjusted analysis with prespecified covariates and state limitations regarding residual confounding.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: The only test performed is Fisher's exact on two binary variables; no other covariates or adjustment methods are present in artifacts.

acceptedFindings.title: Insufficient documentation of study design and cohort construction
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Readers cannot assess selection bias, eligibility criteria, or generalizability, which are essential to interpreting any association.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Describe the data source, sampling method, eligibility criteria, and how the complete-case cohort of 240 was derived. Include a flow chart if possible.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: The manuscript mentions 'Cohort Construction' but provides no details beyond the complete-case N; no definition of the source population.

acceptedFindings.title: Exploratory result presented as interpretable local evidence
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: The stats-qa explicitly marks the run as exploratory and unbound, warning that it cannot support paper-ready conclusions. The manuscript’s assertion that it produced 'interpretable local evidence' overstates the certainty and misleads readers.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Align the conclusion with the result posture: clearly state that this is an exploratory analysis not yet ready for inference, and downgrade any claims.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Compare manuscript discussion (e.g., 'The analysis produced interpretable local evidence') with stats-qa resultPosture.status = 'exploratory_standard_table' and its 'cannotSupport' list.

acceptedFindings.title: Missing definitions of outcome, treatment, and covariates
evidenceRefs: manuscript.md: Methods section states 'The primary outcome, exposure, and covariates were not fully encoded in the text report'
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Without clear variable definitions, readers cannot assess the clinical significance or potential confounding.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Add explicit definitions of outcome_binary and treatment, and list any covariates considered.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check manuscripts for presence of definitions of outcome_binary and treatment.

acceptedFindings.title: No confidence interval reported for the odds ratio
evidenceRefs: stats-run/stats-run.json: estimates array only includes odds_ratio and p_value, no ci_lower/ci_upper
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Confidence intervals provide essential information about precision and clinical significance, beyond p-values.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Compute and report 95% CI for odds ratio (e.g., using exact method from Fisher's test) and include in estimates and manuscript.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check if estimates contain ci_lower and ci_upper fields.

acceptedFindings.title: Complete-case analysis without reporting missing data patterns or sensitivity
evidenceRefs: manuscript.md: mentions complete-case n=240 but no missingness details
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Missing data can bias results if non-random. Complete-case analysis may discard informative cases.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Report the number and proportion of missing cases, compare characteristics of complete vs incomplete, and consider multiple imputation or sensitivity analysis.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Look for missingness report artifact or documentation of excluded observations.

acceptedFindings.title: Conclusion of 'interpretable local evidence' overstates the exploratory nature
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Overclaiming can mislead readers about the strength of evidence, especially if no confounder adjustment or design rigor.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Tone down conclusion to 'exploratory finding' and explicitly state that no causal inference should be drawn.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check that the manuscript's conclusion uses exploratory language and disclaims causality.

acceptedFindings.title: No raw data or data availability statement
evidenceRefs: stats-run/stats-run.json: contains only summary tables, no data artifact
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Reproducibility requires access to underlying data; without it, results cannot be independently verified.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Provide de-identified dataset or a clear data availability statement indicating where and under what conditions data can be accessed.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check for existence of a data file (e.g., CSV) with raw records.

acceptedFindings.title: Missingness and complete-case assumptions not examined
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Complete-case analysis can introduce bias if missingness is related to exposure, outcome, or covariates. No missing-data diagnostics or sensitivity analysis is provided.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Report the number of excluded records, reasons, and patterns of missingness. Consider multiple imputation or, at minimum, a discussion of possible bias.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Artifacts show only a complete-case N=240; no documentation of initial sample size or missingness patterns.

acceptedFindings.title: No code or full data provided for independent reproduction
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Although the contingency table allows recomputation of the Fisher test, the data processing steps (filtering, variable coding) are absent, limiting full reproducibility.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Include the analysis script (e.g., R/Python) and a de‑identified dataset or a data‑generating seed, or clearly state that only summary statistics can be shared.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: No code files (.R, .py, .do) are listed in the artifact manifest; only summary artifacts.

acceptedFindings.title: No justification for Fisher's exact test over chi-square with n=240
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Standard approach for 2x2 tables with expected counts >5 is chi-square; Fisher's is typically for small samples or sparse tables. Method choice should be explained.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Justify the choice, e.g., if any expected cell count <5, or if exact test preferred for robustness. Provide expected counts.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check if expected counts are provided and any justification for Fisher's exact test is documented.

acceptedFindings.title: Figure (contingency heatmap) not referenced or included in manuscript
acceptedFindings.whyItMatters: Figures enhance communication but must be integrated into the narrative; otherwise, they are disconnected.
acceptedFindings.actionableFix: Incorporate the figure into the manuscript with proper caption and interpretation.
acceptedFindings.deterministicVerification: Check that the manuscript PDF or text includes the figure and references it.

finding.title: No reference to existing literature
finding.whyItMatters: Contextualising findings within prior work is standard for external dissemination; its absence limits the ability to judge novelty or consistency.
finding.actionableFix: Add a brief literature review or, if intended for internal use only, state that no literature comparison is performed.

rejectedFindings.reason: Low-severity single-reviewer finding kept as advisory but not accepted for automatic repair.

reviewAdjudication.nextAction: Route back to exploration with review-response decisions.
